item.title: One person dead after fiery Eagle Mountain crash
item.description: One person is dead after a serious crash in Eagle Mountain Wednesday afternoon.

item.title: ‘Blindsided’ by new homeless campus, west side lawmakers want a seat at the table
item.description: As Utah leaders weigh building a 1,300-bed homeless campus on the northwest side of Salt Lake City, two lawmakers worry their constituents are being left out of the decision process.

item.title: Former FBI agent says surveillance video points to ‘amateur’ in Nancy Guthrie kidnapping
item.description: A retired FBI agent said new surveillance images from the home of Nancy Guthrie, the missing mother of “Today" show anchor Savannah Guthrie, suggest the person who abducted her may have been an inexperienced kidnapper.

item.title: Snow storm gives rusty drivers refresher course for Cottonwood Canyons traction law
item.description: Even a trace of snow was enough to get drivers lining up to enter Salt Lake's Cottonwood Canyons on Wednesday, where they were reminded of the state's traction law.

item.title: Does Utah’s court system need a transparency overhaul? State lawmakers think so
item.description: Utah House Speaker Mike Schultz backs a new bill to increase transparency throughout Utah's court system. HB540 aims to do just that.

item.title: Wiles and Moltzan: Bronze, and building the next generation
item.description: Bronze and leadership go hand-in-hand as two Olympic medalists with ties to Utah help their young teammates learn in Italy.

item.title: Residents call high‑rise apartment fire a ‘miracle escape’ after flames contained to one unit
item.description: Fire at the Canyon Road Towers in Salt Lake City was contained to one unit. Some residents are thankful for the type of walls used in the construction.

item.title: Jaren Jackson Jr. Dazzles In Home Debut As Jazz Beat Kings
item.description: The Utah Jazz defeated the Sacramento Kings 121-93 on Wednesday in Jaren Jackson Jr.'s home debut.

item.title: Mother speaks out after son’s death in West Valley carbon monoxide incident
item.description: A mother spoke out Wednesday about her son’s death and called for accountability in the case of her son's death, along with 2 other men. The men died of carbon monoxide poisoning after being left in a running vehicle in a garage by a care worker.

item.title: Proposed Utah bill takes aim at hidden rental fees by forcing landlords to show total rental price in listings
item.description: A proposed Utah law would ban hidden rental fees by requiring landlords to advertise the true monthly cost up front, after renters like Rachel Ortiz say surprise add-ons are blowing carefully planned budgets.
